note: References: 15m-52d 16 trades, 1h-130d 85 trades. Cells that improved a book but were not profitable on both: 0.
verdict: NO on the reclaim cap, NO on the retest alternative, NO on the fail-fast scratch, and NO on the combination. No cell was profitable on both the 15m spec book and the 1h book. The grid was 170 cells, fixed before the run (18 reclaim, 8 scratch, 144 combined). A cell that only improves one book, or that improves both halves and still loses, does not turn a flag on. All 38 1h-130d pairs of 90 and 120 minutes matched, because both windows first come due on the bar two hours after the fill. 38 of 38 15m-52d pairs of 90 and 120 minutes differed. On 15m those windows are separate rules. The wide-reclaim clue was the first half of the 1h book (losers had wider reclaim bars). The second half of that book flipped, and it was not used to change the grid. MFE, MAE, and time-to-target are path stats. Using them as an exit is still a look at the same trades that suggested them. Order flow was off. Monday paper stays on the spec defaults.
